name: Telephone set symbol
summary: Symbol for a telephone instrument, drawn as a handset shape, used on communication layouts and schematics.
description: The telephone set symbol shows the instrument itself, usually as a stylised handset over a base or a circle with a handset. It appears on communication system diagrams, lift and emergency phone schematics and on plans where a fixed phone is supplied.

Where a phone is provided as part of a system, such as a lift car phone, help point or emergency phone, the symbol distinguishes the supplied device from a simple outlet. The plan then tags the device type. The symbol does not tell you whether the instrument is analogue, IP or hands-free.
readingNotes: Check whether the instrument is supplied or only the outlet.
distinction: A telephone outlet is the termination; the telephone set symbol is the instrument.
